play_contract.counterexample: Compare a strong recoil-only passage, a stopped bay crossing and the intended two-cell phrase. Never claim continuous air if the real bay was touched.
play_contract.decision: Use the inner observation bay as a stable beat, or keep the next side-hook/recoil phrase airborne through the downward elbow.
play_contract.observe: The first horizontal cell opens into a lower second cell; pale thorns are attached to the actual cap and lower bark.
play_contract.recovery: A miss reaches real inner/outer root floors. The world must connect those different low ports into its root loop.

recovery.consumer_required: Connect lower ports into the real root network; no isolated ladder or assumed return to the high entry.
